ns2:section.sectionText: Global Studies: Diversity and Integration in Salvador da Bahia. This course focuses on Brazils role in the African diaspora and how African migration has mingled with early Brazilian settler culture to form the uniquely Afro-Brazilian heritage that typifies Bahia. More information at: http://www.las.uiuc.edu/coursesabroad/winter.html The course starts during the 2nd 8 weeks term and is completed in Salvador da Bahia, Brazil 12/26-1/13. First year Discovery Program course. Students should only enroll in one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
